from pathlib import Path

OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_training_tail_policy_clock_explanation_v1'
if (OUT/'result.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('本次固定解释已有结果，不重跑。')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def clean(v):
    if isinstance(v,dict):return {str(k):clean(z) for k,z in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v,list):return [clean(z) for z in v]
    if isinstance(v,(datetime,pd.Timestamp)):return v.isoformat()
    if isinstance(v,float) and not math.isfinite(v):return None
    return v
def save(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('禁止覆盖本次解释记录：'+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(clean(obj),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

def binding(pattern):
    m=re.search(pattern,s)
